cues: A quiet afternoon began with him choosing a mystery from the collection beside his reading chair.
She labeled sections by subject so visitors could find gardening guides without searching every title.
When the room was rearranged, the tall display moved beside the desk to keep reference books handy.
He added a small lamp nearby, making evening reading easier while keeping favorite authors within reach.
The twins took turns returning storybooks after bedtime, keeping the family’s reading corner orderly.
A borrowed biography stayed near the front until its owner remembered to take it back to the library.
